about: Machine-readable work queues for the six workstreams. GitHub Issues hold each story; this file says which story each workstream is on, what comes next and what blocks it. The orchestrator thread updates it at the weekly review and when a lead reports a story done. Check and render with: python docs/product/operations/tools/queues.py all

rules.needs_chris: New user-facing features need a mockup and Chris's typed go; Fabric capacity or cloud spend needs his typed yes. Such stories are blocked, never ready, until he answers.
